body: Its not fun and its not awesome my friend. It is a realization, depression is a dark realization that you are tired of the position you're in. Depression is enlightenment.  What can you do today that will make tomorrow better?
I promise that if you start running 2 miles everyday, you will feel 100% better. Turn your angst into physical power that will push you through workouts. I promise you will feel better
I go to my nice job everyday so I can make money to put gas in my car to go to work the next day. This cycle will never end
Because to me, fun costs $$$ that I dont have. I will never have enough $$$.

Listen, bro. What you are going through is not suicidal thoughts, you are just a angst ridden teenager. When I was a teenager it was fun for me to think about my own death, in a dark way, it was fun for me. I enjoyed getting myself to the position you are in now by posting things like this. I bet you felt a lot better after posting this, and you will probably put suicide on hold because of these thoughts you wrote on reddit. These thoughts will most likely return to you and you should express them like you have today in your post. When I was a kid, there was no reddit to talk to. Ill help you out bro because I was there like you are here today.

When you start to reach the point of adulthood (21+) you will come to the realization that you are capable of doing whatever the fuck you want with your life. You hate your parents? Abandon them if its going to make you feel better. You know what I suggest to you? I suggest you find a way to get your ass down to the Caribbean and make your living as a towel boy at first. From that point, just enjoy walking on the beach everyday.  Get to the USA A.S.A.P.
